environment.description: Ruby on Rails 7.1 API running in a Docker container on ECS Fargate. Container runs with default capabilities. Application is behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no additional middleware. PostgreSQL RDS backend with documents table containing user_id foreign key. No row-level security policies on the database. API tokens are issued per-user with no scope restrictions.

config.database: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS, no RLS policies
